title: Small Group Scenic Wekiva River Kayak Tour near Orlando
includes: A professional medically trained certified kayak guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We recommend you bring a swim suit, warm wool or fleece top (winter), waterproof rain jacket or poncho, sun protection (sunhat, sunglasses, sun screen), a camera, and a towel to dry off afterwards.
policies: It is recommended you wear quick dry clothes and water/river shoes
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on an enriching adventure with our expert-guided Wekiva River tour, limited to 10 people for a personalized and high-quality experience. Encounter alligators, wading birds, otters, and manatees in the protected waters. As you paddle, our passionate guides share insights, ensuring an unforgettable and inspiring adventure. Safety is paramount with professionally trained guides. Fuel up with energizing trail snacks, adding a delightful touch to your kayak exploration.
